# Kapot

> Kapot is a Belgium-wide inline skating community organising events, contests and lessons. We welcome rollerbladers of all ages and skill levels from across the country.

Kapot teaches aggressive inline skating, hosts Belgium's annual Kapot Contest, and supports inline events nationwide. By and for the inline skating community.

## Lessons

Group lessons are currently held in Leuven (location may change in the future). Private sessions are arranged with individual teachers, mainly in Leuven, Brussels, Antwerp and Gent, and anywhere in the Benelux.

- **Sunday Group Class**: 10 lessons for €80. Group lessons in aggressive inline skating (rollerblading) for all levels, beginners welcome. Every Sunday, in two time windows: 9:30–11:00 and 11:00–12:30, open to youth (6–22) and adults (23+). Held at Sportoase skatepark, Leuven. When it rains, the class moves to Stelplaats indoor skatepark, Leuven, announced in advance. Protection gear and helmet obligatory. Kapot is a skate club under Skate Vlaanderen: annual membership is €40 and includes sports insurance, also internationally. Sign up: https://tally.so/r/wAY26B
- **Private session**: €40 per hour, by appointment. Mainly in Leuven, Brussels, Antwerp and Gent, and anywhere in the Benelux. Privately taught by one of our teachers. One pair of adaptable junior aggressive skates available — ask in advance. All ages and levels welcome. Book: https://calendly.com/kapot/private-session

## Events

- **Kapot Contest 2027**, date and location to be announced. Belgium's annual celebration of inline skating, with skaters from around the world. Free entry. 2026 edition: https://www.facebook.com/events/1298588894932094/
- **Nocturnus**, mid August at Blaarmeersen skatepark, Gent. Annual all-night inline skate jam, lights on until morning. Free.
